# Rome.net

> Comprehensive travel guide for Rome, Italy covering major attractions like the Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Roman Forum, St. Peter's Basilica, plus practical information on ATAC public transport, accommodations, and day trips.

Rome.net is a complete visitor resource providing detailed guides to Rome's iconic landmarks, churches, and archaeological sites, along with practical travel planning tools including transport tickets (BIT, MetroBus passes), hotel and apartment booking, and excursions to nearby destinations like Tivoli.

## Key Topics

- Vatican Museums
- Sistine Chapel
- Colosseum
- Roman Forum
- St. Peter's Basilica
- ATAC public transport
- OMNIA Rome & Vatican Card
- Forum Pass Super
- Basilica of St. John Lateran
- MetroBus travel cards
- Contactless payment (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay)
- Day trips from Rome
- Archaeological sites
- Rome accommodations

## Major Attractions & Churches

- [St. Peter's Basilica - Opening hours, price and location – Rome](https://www.rome.net/st-peters-basilica): St. Peter's Basilica visitor guide with Michelangelo's dome & Pieta
- [Basilica of St. John Lateran - One of Rome's important churches](https://www.rome.net/basilica-st-john-lateran): Guide to Basilica of St. John Lateran, Rome's cathedral church

## Accommodations

- [Apartments in Rome - Apartment deals in Rome](https://www.rome.net/apartments): Apartment rentals and lodging options for Rome travelers

- [Rome Transport Tickets - Tickets, Travel Cards & Transport Passes](https://www.rome.net/rome-transport-tickets): Guide to ATAC public transport tickets, travel cards & passes in Rome
